title: C. Magical Girl and White Rabbits

legend: Madoka was originally an ordinary student who went to school happily every day. However, one day she was suddenly persuaded to become a magical girl, and thus began her endless battles against enemies to protect the world.

The transportation network of this world is shaped like a complete $$$k$$$-ary tree with $$$l$$$ levels. Her base is located in Central City, which is located at the root node (level $$$1$$$), and all enemies lurk at the leaves (level $$$l$$$). Every non-leaf node has exactly $$$k$$$ children, which are ordered from left to right as its $$$1$$$-st, $$$2$$$-nd, $$$\dots$$$, $$$k$$$-th child, exactly as they are drawn in the picture below. Given $$$k$$$ and $$$l$$$, we can determine the total number of nodes in the tree (denoted $$$S$$$), which is at most $$$10^6$$$. Below is an example transportation network with $$$k = 3$$$ and $$$l = 4$$$, where $$$S=40$$$:
Over time, Madoka has already completed $$$n$$$ enemy extermination missions sequentially. For each mission, she started her journey from Central City.

However, the enemies are not the only threat. There exists a special kind of mysterious "white rabbit" in this world that Madoka finds extremely annoying and difficult to deal with. To conserve her precious magical energy for the actual battles, Madoka actively chooses which enemy to hunt based on the safest route. She evaluates the routes to all leaves and always selects a root-to-leaf path that contains the minimum total number of white rabbits along the way.

Several different paths may share this minimum total, so Madoka fixes her route in the following deterministic way. She walks down from the root one node at a time. Standing at a non-leaf node $$$v$$$, she looks at every child $$$c$$$ of $$$v$$$ that keeps her on a path of the minimum total (that is, the number of white rabbits on the road from $$$v$$$ to $$$c$$$, plus the minimum number of white rabbits on a path from $$$c$$$ down to a leaf of $$$c$$$'s subtree, is as small as possible among all children of $$$v$$$), and she always steps into the leftmost such child, that is, the one with the smallest index among them. She repeats this until she arrives at a leaf.

Unfortunately, these white rabbits have a strange affinity for magical girls and are strongly attracted to Madoka's magical trail. After she completes the $$$i$$$-th mission, her residual magic instantly triggers a rapid multiplication of the creatures. Specifically, on every single road segment that Madoka just traveled across during that mission, the number of white rabbits permanently occupying that road increases by $$$w_i$$$. (Initially, the world was peaceful, and there were $$$0$$$ white rabbits on all roads.)

As the missions pile up, the network becomes increasingly congested with these white rabbits. Madoka needs to know how bad the situation has eventually become. Determine the total number of white rabbits Madoka will inevitably encounter on her chosen path during her NEXT ($$$n+1$$$)-th extermination mission.
input: The first line contains three integers $$$k$$$, $$$l$$$, and $$$n$$$, representing the branching factor of the tree, the number of levels, and the number of completed missions.
The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$w_1, w_2, \dots, w_n$$$, representing the sequence of values by which the white rabbits increase on the traveled road segments after each mission.
The total number of nodes in the tree does not exceed $$$10^6$$$.
output: Output a single integer representing the total number of white rabbits on the path Madoka will choose during her NEXT ($$$n+1$$$)-th mission.
note: The tree has $$$4$$$ leaves, numbered $$$1$$$ to $$$4$$$ from left to right; leaves $$$1$$$ and $$$2$$$ belong to the root's $$$1$$$-st child, leaves $$$3$$$ and $$$4$$$ to its $$$2$$$-nd child. Over the five missions Madoka visited leaves $$$1$$$, $$$3$$$, $$$2$$$, $$$4$$$, $$$1$$$.

The first two missions are the ones that use the tie-breaking rule. In mission $$$1$$$, every road was still empty, so all four routes tied; she went into the left child at the root and again at the next node, reaching leaf $$$1$$$. In mission $$$2$$$, the four routes cost $$$2$$$, $$$1$$$, $$$0$$$, $$$0$$$: at the root the $$$2$$$-nd child was strictly better, and there its two leaves tied at $$$0$$$, so she took the leftmost of them, leaf $$$3$$$. In the remaining three missions, the route with the fewest white rabbits was unique: leaf $$$2$$$ at cost $$$1$$$, then leaf $$$4$$$ at cost $$$2$$$, then leaf $$$1$$$ at cost $$$5$$$.

After these $$$5$$$ missions, the four routes cost $$$15$$$, $$$12$$$, $$$8$$$ and $$$10$$$, respectively. Thus, for her next mission, Madoka takes the path to leaf $$$3$$$ and will inevitably encounter exactly $$$8$$$ white rabbits.

legend: 圆香原本是个普通的学生，每天开开心心地上学。然而，有一天她突然被说服成为一名魔法少女，从此开始了为了保护世界而与敌人进行的无休止战斗。

这个世界的交通网络形状像一棵完整的 $$$k$$$-元素树，具有 $$$l$$$ 级别。它的基地位于中心城，位于根节点 (级别 $$$1$$$)，所有敌人都潜伏在叶子 (级别 $$$l$$$)。每个非叶子节点都有 $$$k$$$ 个子节点，这些子节点从左到右依次为其 $$$1$$$-st、$$$2$$$-nd、$$$\dots$$$、$$$k$$$-th 子节点，如下图所示。给定 $$$k$$$ 和 $$$l$$$，我们可以确定树中节点的总数 (表示为 $$$S$$$)，最多为 $$$10^6$$$。下面是一个具有 $$$k = 3$$$ 和 $$$l = 4$$$ 的交通网络示例，其中 $$$S=40$$$:
随着时间的推移，圆香已经依次完成了 $$$n$$$ 歼灭敌人的任务。每次任务，她都是从中央市开始她的旅程。
然而，敌人并不是唯一的威胁。这个世界存在一种特殊的神秘 “白兔”，圆华觉得它极其烦人且难以对付。为了节省宝贵的魔力以应对实际战斗，圆华主动选择最安全的路线来猎杀敌人。她评估通往所有树叶的路线，总是选择一条从根到叶的路径，这条路径沿途包含最少数量的白兔。

几条不同的路径可能共享这个最小总和，所以 Madoka 以下面这种确定性的方式确定她的路线。她从根部一个节点一个节点地向下走。站在一个非叶子节点 $$$v$$$，她观察 $$$v$$$ 的每个 $$$c$$$ 子节点，这些子节点使她走在一条最小总和的路径上 (即从 $$$v$$$ 到 $$$c$$$ 的路上的白兔数量，加上从 $$$c$$$ 到 $$$c$$$ 子树的一片叶子的路径上的最小白兔数量，在 $$$v$$$ 的所有子节点中尽可能小)，她总是走到这样的子节点的最左边，也就是索引最小的那个。她重复这个过程，直到到达一片叶子。
遗憾的是，这些白兔对魔法少女有着奇怪的亲和力，并且强烈地被圆华的魔法踪迹所吸引。圆华完成 $$$i$$$ 任务后，她残留的魔力立刻引发了生物的快速增殖。具体来说，圆华在那个任务中刚刚经过的每一个道路段，永久占据那条道路的白兔数量都会以 $$$w_i$$$ 的速度增加。(最初，世界是和平的，所有道路上都有 $$$0$$$ 白兔。)
随着任务的堆积，网络变得越来越拥挤，充满了这些白兔。Madoka 需要知道情况最终变得有多糟糕。确定 Madoka 在她的第二次 ($$$n+1$$$) 歼灭任务中不可避免地会在她选择的路径上遇到的白兔总数。
input: 第一行包含三个整数 $$$k$$$、$$$l$$$ 和 $$$n$$$，分别表示树的分叉率、层数和完成的任务数。
第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 整数 $$$w_1, w_2, \dots, w_n$$$，表示每次任务后白兔在已经走过的路段上增加的值序列。
树中节点的总数不超过 $$$10^6$$$。
output: 输出一个整数，表示 Madoka 在她的 NEXT($$$n+1$$$) 任务中将选择的路径上白兔的总数。
note: 前两个任务是使用分离规则的任务。在任务 $$$1$$$ 中，每条路都还是空的，所以四条路线都是相连的;她在根部进入左边的子任务，然后在下一个节点再次进入，到达叶子 $$$1$$$。在任务 $$$2$$$ 中，四条路线的代价是 $$$2$$$、$$$1$$$、$$$0$$$、$$$0$$$:在根部 $$$2$$$ 第三个子任务严格来说更好，那里它的两片叶子都与 $$$0$$$ 相连，所以她选择了最左边的叶子 $$$3$$$。在剩下的三个任务中，白兔数量最少的路线是独特的：叶子 $$$2$$$ 代价是 $$$1$$$，然后叶子 $$$4$$$ 代价是 $$$2$$$，然后叶子 $$$1$$$ 代价是 $$$5$$$。
在这些 $$$5$$$ 任务之后，四条路线分别需要 $$$15$$$、$$$12$$$、$$$8$$$ 和 $$$10$$$。因此，在她的下一个任务中，Madoka 选择了前往 $$$3$$$ 叶子的路线，并且不可避免地会遇到与 $$$8$$$ 完全相同的白兔。
